senses.gloss: f. pl. (transpos. of לִיטְרָא) Librae (pounds), v. לִיטְרָא.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:10:2">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>מנה דבילה</he> Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:12">ib. V, 12</cite>) <he>אמר רב מנא ארבע ר׳</he> (not <he>וארבע</he>) R. M. says, it means four pounds (of figs).
